system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: The periodic HTTPS activity is consistent with the approved PixelForge updater: pfupdater.exe ran from the inventoried path, and proxy requests from the workstation repeatedly named updates.pixelforge-suite.com.
Network events associate pfupdater.exe (PID 3788) with connections to the explicit proxy on port 8080, including a successful tunnel at 13:41 UTC.
The proxy records show both successful tunnels and failed requests: some attempts returned status 200, while others were denied with 403 and one earlier attempt required authentication with 407.

The window also contains SMB and LDAP traffic between the workstation and DC-NWD-01, with Kerberos records identifying the workstation machine account. The supplied records do not establish that this activity is malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: Successful proxy CONNECT records show the requested hostname and tunnel metadata, but the supplied records do not expose the HTTPS payload or establish what content was exchanged (for example, T036-00142 and T036-00254).
The supplied SMB records show connections and authentication, but not the accessed shares, files, or operations (for example, T036-00118, T036-00270, and T036-00308).
The supplied evidence does not include a binary hash or signature-verification result for pfupdater.exe (process and network records include T036-00097 and T036-00102).
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish the integrity or provenance of the pfupdater.exe binary beyond its logged path and process identity (T036-00097, T036-00102).

The evidence does not establish the exact contents or purpose of the successful HTTPS exchanges because the available proxy records describe CONNECT tunnels (T036-00142, T036-00176, T036-00206, T036-00254).
The evidence does not establish the purpose or accessed resources of the workstation's SMB sessions to DC-NWD-01 (T036-00118, T036-00270, T036-00308).
The supplied records do not show svc-render password rotation or a RenderQueue update during this window.
additional_evidence_needed: No additional evidence is required to close this periodic-HTTPS alert on the supplied evidence. If the separate SMB activity is investigated, collect DC share-access auditing and endpoint details identifying the process or operation responsible.
